bug_1: src/core.ts compareRapVsStandard compared RAP only with Tiered Standard (lower_total_paid = rap < tiered ? rap : tiered), ignoring the 10-year Standard; src/tools.ts summary hard-coded 'Only RAP counts toward PSLF'.
fix_1: Ranks every available plan (RAP, Tiered Standard, 10-year Standard if available) by computed monthly and total; adds lowest_monthly_payment_plans and lowest_total_paid_plans (ties reported); lower_total_paid/lower_monthly_payment keep their names and now hold the true minimum.
pslf_rule: 20 U.S.C. 1087e(m)(1)(A) as amended by P.L. 119-21 sec. 82004: (i) IBR, (ii) 10-year Standard under 455(d)(1)(A), (iii) other 455(d)(1)/(g) plans paying at least the 10-year Standard amount, (iv) ICR as in effect before its repeal, (v) on-time RAP payments. Tiered Standard (455(d)(7)(A)(i)) is not listed; StudentAid.gov SAVE FAQ Q10 (Oct 2026) says Tiered Standard payments do not count.
fix_2: Summary now says 'RAP and the 10-year Standard plan count toward PSLF; Tiered Standard does not.' (or 'RAP counts toward PSLF; Tiered Standard does not.' when the 10-year Standard is unavailable). standard_10_year.pslf_qualifying=true with note that 120 payments under it pay the loan off. New pslf object with citations.
